Our Story

18 Years In The Making

The foundations of NetGarde were laid in 2008 under the banner of Wolf Engineering.

Founded by Eugen Wolf, the firm was conceived as a high-tier engineering collective, consolidating a rare talent pool of military engineers, career defense specialists, and veterans from specialized state services.

Our team was formed with a singular objective: to solve the most complex technical challenges faced by modern defense forces.

Over 18 years, this heritage has evolved into a comprehensive ecosystem of expertise, moving from bespoke engineering consultations to the Tier-1 production of mission-critical hardware and software.
